name: sparkles-title
title: Sparkles Title
description: A hero block with a glowing blue arc at the bottom, a faint grid, tiny rising sparkle particles, a small white logo tile and a centred white headline over a short paragraph.
use: A product's front page needs a calm, atmospheric hero that puts a logo, name and one-sentence pitch front and centre.
avoid: The particles run continuously and the block is hardcoded black, so it fights a light theme and never stops.
a11y: The sparkle canvas has no accessible name or reduced-motion handling, and the logo mark is an empty box with no alt text. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a soft blue glow rises from the bottom centre inside a wide dome, with a fine grid of faint lines across the top and small white specks drifting upward. A white rounded-square logo sits above a centred white headline and two small grey lines of copy.
behaves: The background sparkles drift slowly upward and fade in and out while the blue glow and grid stay still. Hovering or clicking adds particles, but the title and copy never move.
customise: The headline is a title prop and the paragraph is children; the logo, glow colours, grid, particle density and direction are hardcoded in the markup and sparkle options.
weight: heavy: A canvas particle engine draws 400 sparkles every frame, forever.
